description: Loops API key hardcoded as a LOOPS_API_KEY constant in a Next.js server action (detected), as a quoted "LOOPS_API_KEY" entry in the committed dev container containerEnv (detected only since the rule accepts a quoted key), and inline in `new LoopsClient("…")` from the official SDK. The constructor form has no LOOPS_API_KEY name for the context-anchored rule to key on — known gap.
